card.name: Small words before an expected noun
card.fires_on: Short linking words (his, its, we, in, should, or) and some nouns that sit just before the next noun or verb in a clause. The next word is predictable from the grammar, such as a possessive before a noun.

modes.label: Possessives and pronouns
modes.description: A possessive or pronoun that starts a noun phrase right after a verb or noun.

modes.label: Subject or linking word
modes.description: A short word such as in, or, or should that links a subject to its verb or phrase.
